name: three-presenter
description: Framework-agnostic 3D viewer library built on Three.js

scripts.build:demo: npm run build && cp -r dist/* docs/dist/
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run docs && cp -r dist/* docs/dist/
scripts.// build: Production build: bundle library + TypeScript declarations
scripts.// build:demo: Build library + copy artifacts to docs/dist/ (for local preview)
scripts.// build:all: Build library + generate API docs + copy to docs/dist/
scripts.// dev: Start Vite dev server (HMR, fast refresh)
scripts.// dev:watch: Watch mode: rebuild library on file changes (dev build)
scripts.// dev:docs: Watch + auto-build + copy to docs/dist/ (for docs/demo iteration)
scripts.// dev:live: Auto-build + static server (http://localhost:3000) — one-command local dev
scripts.// preview: Preview production build with Vite's server
scripts.// serve: Serve docs folder at http://localhost:3000 (static server)
scripts.// docs: Generate TypeDoc API documentation into docs/api/

author: CNR-ISTI Visual Computing Lab
